synopsis_en: This will be the last national situation report for 2026. A summary of the 2026 fire season will be provided later this fall.
synopsis_fr: Il s’agit du dernier rapport sur la situation nationale pour 2026. Un résumé de la saison des feux de 2026 sera fourni plus tard cet automne.
preparedness_en:
Canada is at National Preparedness Level 2, indicating that resources within most agencies are adequate to manage their current situation, and there is light to moderate demand and mobilization of resources occurring through CIFFC. All fire management agencies are at 2 or lower or not reporting. 

 

The number of fires is about the 10-year average for this time of year, and area burned is also about average or just below. At the time of this report, there are no outstanding requests for domestic resources, all of the international resources have demobilized and returned home, and resources that have been mobilized domestically are being returned. 

 

The United States is at preparedness level 3, indicating mobilization of resources nationally is required to sustain incident management operations, and mobilization of resources through the National Interagency Coordination Centre is moderate to heavy.
